light_description: Original Nagoya R Diner Sounds overdrive based on a transparent-style drive concept with selectable 9V/18V operation and clipping modes.
Later SPICE CURRY generation documented by the current R Diner Sounds shop and Japanese dealer catalog.
Original R Diner Sounds amplifier-like distortion inspired by Nagoya miso-katsu, with a dedicated MISO character control and three-band EQ.
Later MISOKATSU generation preserved in the current R Diner Sounds catalog.
Fourth R Diner Sounds release, explicitly introduced as a fuzz in the current ABiRu-operated catalog.
